capabilities: Chat with an agent using notes, files and folders as context
Generate and edit Excalidraw drawings from chat prompts
Annotate selected preview content and send it with a message
Review and approve agent tool actions before they run
Share notes, images or folders as webpages with generated links
extras: Marketplace listing carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. Sharing keeps content on the user's machine but requires Seed and Web Publishing to stay running and online; published links cannot be recalled once obtained, and preview links expire after ten minutes. Table-column resizing works even with Seed closed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to work with an external AI agent over vault context while approving each sensitive action before it runs.

relations.evidence: Connect your vault to Agent Harness in MotusAI Seed.
Generate hand-drawn flowcharts, mind maps and schematics with Excalidraw, then open and edit them

summary: AI agent client that connects the vault to MotusAI Seed's Agent Harness for chat, Excalidraw drawing, and webpage sharing.
